First public release.

readscout lets Claude Code and Codex hand large reads to a small model running on your own GPU. Your agent sends paths
and a question, and gets back a few lines where **every claim carries a quote verified word for word in the source**,
with its real `file:line`. Nothing leaves your machine.

## Install

Windows (PowerShell):
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/main/install.ps1 | iex
```
macOS / Linux:
```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/main/install.sh | sh
```
Claude Code plugin:
```text
/plugin marketplace add Anarchiejs/readscout
/plugin install readscout@readscout
```
Manual: `uv tool install https://github.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/releases/download/v0.1.0/readscout-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl`,
then `readscout setup`. Full guide: [README](https://github.com/Anarchiejs/readscout#readme).

## What's inside

- **Three MCP tools:** `local_ask` (read files or folders and answer with verified quotes), `local_digest` (find the
  root cause in a long log), `local_edit` (apply a small, fully specified change, kept only if your tests pass).
- **Trust by construction:** schema-constrained output, findings without a verbatim quote are dropped, line numbers
  computed by readscout, negative questions routed to the bigger model, edits restored byte for byte on failure.
- **Setup page:** hardware detection with sliders, model recommendations, one-click model install, Claude Code / Codex
  wiring, project folders, readiness check.
- **Models per machine** from a measured catalog (`gemma4:e4b`, `gemma4:12b`, `gemma4:26b`, `gemma4:e2b`).
- **Public benchmark:** `readscout bench` runs 25 reading tasks on four MIT repositories pinned by commit and content
  fingerprint, plus 7 edit tasks with hidden checks, and prints a report to share.
- **Safety:** loopback-only models, no tools for the model, registered folders only, sensitive files refused, secrets
  masked, local setup page protected by Host/Origin checks and a per-session token.

## Measured (RTX 4060 Ti 8 GB, 32 GB RAM)

| Model | Reading (F1) | Edits | Seconds per task |
|---|---|---|---|
| gemma4:26b | 0.91 | 6.8/7 | 20 |
| gemma4:12b | 0.91 | 6/7 | 23 |
| gemma4:e4b | 0.85 | 7/7 | 5 |

Details in [docs/BENCHMARK.md](https://github.com/Anarchiejs/readscout/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARK.md). Run
`readscout bench` on your GPU and share the table in an issue: that is how the catalog grows.

Tested end to end on Windows 11 and Ubuntu 24.04; unit tests run on Windows, macOS and Linux (Python 3.11 and 3.13).
